items.title: Ransomware Gang Goes Full 'Godfather' With Cartel
items.description: Since its launch in 2023, DragonForce has pushed a cartel model, emphasizing cooperation and coordination among ransomware gangs.

items.title: CISA Makes Unpublicized Ransomware Updates to KEV Catalog
items.description: A third of the "flipped" CVEs affected network edge devices, leading one researcher to conclude, "Ransomware operators are building playbooks around your perimeter."
